# Compatibility gaps

<!-- Generated by `bun run --cwd packages/link compat:gaps`; edit the generator, not this file. -->

From the camera catalog and the simulation matrix of 2026-10-28. The same report is the `/gaps` page of `bun run compat:ui`.

- **Library:** 212 vendor operations documented for some line have no darkgrade definition; 5 recorded requests have parameters darkgrade's definitions cannot express.
- **Data:** 6430 of 8570 capability cells (75%) have no data. 41 of 47 lines have no captured or hardware evidence, and 5 have no mock. 31 catalog models are not mocked.
- **Unverified:** 25 catalog models and 12 line quirks are marked unverified by their sources.

## Test Bench workflow qualification

- Full Test Bench prepare → start → recording-state readback → stop → original-media collection is not qualified by this matrix. The recording/workflow layer is developed separately in darkgrade/darkgrade PR #18; integrate it before running those end-to-end scenarios. See docs/test-bench-workflows.md.
- darkgrade01 workflow evidence was collected with the deployed library, not this candidate branch. USB scatter-gather buffers omitted bulk-IN payloads from usbmon; hardware success cannot fill those missing replay bytes. See docs/evidence/darkgrade01-workflows-2026-10-28.md.

<details><summary>Catalog note: nikonDefinitionBoundaries (3)</summary>

- PR #21 adds the previously missing operation definitions; definition presence does not establish a working Test Bench workflow.
- GetEventEx 0x941C uses the cited Z6 III typed queue format; legacy GetEvent 0x90C7 remains a distinct dataset.
- DeleteWirelessProfile 0x90EF remains unavailable: the proposed destructive request had an assumed parameter layout, not reviewed wire evidence.

</details>

<details><summary>Catalog note: testBenchWorkflowBlockers (3)</summary>

- PR #18 remains separate. Its video-recording and video-take modules are required before this branch can simulate the complete active Test Bench prepare/start/state/stop/original-collection pipeline.
- The darkgrade01 deployed baseline proves selected controls, preview and a short Canon preflight recording; it does not physically validate this candidate branch.
- Linux 7.0 usbmon omits the bench's coalesced scatter-gather bulk-IN data. Capture metadata cannot reconstruct missing DeviceInfo/property/media bytes; use a reviewed application-level observer or validated capture backend.

</details>

## Closing a gap

1. Run `bun run compat:hardware -- --usb <vid:pid>` with the camera attached; it streams into `bun run compat:ui`.
2. Record a usbmon capture of the missing requests (the `camera-re-capture` skill) and run `bun run compat:ingest -- --capture <profile-id>=<file.pcapng> --simulate`.
3. Regenerate this file with `bun run compat:gaps`.
